text:
fiona: FYI after today's coordinated unpin we started seeing mismatched model bindings on a tiny subset of dedicated hosts in ap-northeast (canary). opening thread to decide pin vs patch.

deploybot: [automated] action=unpin_runtime runtime=v6.0.0 scope=ap-northeast user=fiona run_id=rb-6001 started=3129999500

zeke: quick triage: errors are 'model_bind_mismatch' during model load for quantized variants. rate ~0.4% within the canary cohort but consistent for ~8m. p99 latency +25ms.

ops-kim: is this runtime-only or model+runtime interaction? any SDK hints?

rachel: looks like a model ABI check failing when runtime kernel selector tries a new path introduced in v6.0.0. We saw a similar signal in staging when we switched the quant packing mode.

mike: runtime team: v6.0.0 included a model-loading optimization that changes expected tensor alignments for quantized models on certain GPUs. The change is correct long-term but needs a compatibility gate for older model builds. We can either pin runtime or roll a small compatible shim into v6.0.0. Shim ETA ~3.5h.

fiona: ops decision: scoped canary pin to v5.9.4 or keep unpinned and accept small error while patching. change window open for 90m. prefer quick canary pin to avoid customer blips.

ops-kim: agree on scoped canary pin. will avoid global roll unless we see >1% or customer reports.

zeke: small pinlist snippet to apply to avoid touching other regions:

```
runtime_pins:
  ap-northeast:
    cohort: canary
    runtime: v5.9.4  # revert canary for model_bind_mismatch
```

ops-kim: running: /deploybot pin runtime v5.9.4 --scope=ap-northeast --cohort=canary --reason "model_bind_mismatch after v6.0.0 unpin"

deploybot: [automated] action=pin_runtime runtime=v5.9.4 scope=ap-northeast cohort=canary user=ops-kim run_id=rb-6001 status=started ts=3130000055

ops-kim: pinned canary, shifting cohort traffic to pinned runtime. watching error rate and load. will wait 10m before next step.

rachel: 6m check: model_bind_mismatch down to 0.03%, p95 back to baseline on canary. No increased errors elsewhere.

mike: confirming repro is gone on pinned nodes. I'll prioritize the shim PR and add a compatibility flag gated by preflight. PR #10012 opened.

fiona: plan: keep canary pinned, block further unpins in the change window. If shim PR merges and we get 2 consecutive clean preflights on canary, schedule a staged unpin: 20% -> 50% -> 100% across 40m windows with telemetry gates.

zeke: assigning follow-ups: @mike runtime shim PR & CI (INC-6001-1), @rachel add quant-model alignment smoke to canary preflight (INC-6001-2), @fiona coordinate staged unpin runbook and release note (INC-6001-3).

ops-kim: /deploybot summary run_id=rb-6001 actions=unpin(v6.0.0,ap-northeast)->pin(v5.9.4,ap-northeast canary) status=canary-pin duration=245s

rachel: support: internal blurb posted; customer comms drafted but on hold pending wider impact assessment.

fiona: thanks all. leaving safehold on further unpins until PR merged + 2 green preflights. closing thread for now. :thumbsup:
